run_learn_kmeans: run k-means clustering on HUBERT feature shards and save the model to disk
run_get_km_model: run a MiniBatchKMeans model with configurable clusters, batch size, and tolerance parameters
run_load_feature_shard: run loading of a single HUBERT feature shard with optional random sampling
run_load_feature: run loading of all HUBERT feature shards across multiple ranks and concatenate them
run_cli_learn_kmeans: run the CLI to learn k-means clusters from HUBERT features with argparse arguments
